structure.unit: Franchises; Sale and Lease of Certain Municipal Public Property; Public Utilities

law.catch_line: Board, etc., for supervision of such works
law.text: Localities contracting with each other pursuant to § 15.2-2124 may also provide in the contract (i) for a board, commission or other body as deemed appropriate; (ii) for the supervision, general management and operation of such works or structures; and (iii) may prescribe their authority, duties and compensation.
